name: iPlayPC
subtitle: Steam Remote Play for iPhone
description: Stream your PC's Steam games to iPhone and iPad over your local network. Releases are published automatically from github.com/reefbarman/iPlayPC.

apps.name: iPlayPC
apps.subtitle: Steam Remote Play over your local network
apps.localizedDescription:
Play with on-screen virtual controls or a supported controller such as an Xbox controller, DualSense or Backbone. By default, virtual controls stay out of the way while a controller is connected.

Stream games from a PC running Steam to your iPhone or iPad over Wi-Fi, using Steam's own Remote Play. Automatic PC discovery and PIN pairing, hardware HEVC/H.264 decoding with Metal, HDR from supported PCs, rumble, gyro aiming, the phone keyboard for typing, voice chat and Wake-on-LAN. Tuned for the iPhone Duo's inner screen, and works on any iPhone or iPad running iOS 17 or later.

versions.localizedDescription: See the release notes on GitHub.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: iPlayPC finds and connects to PCs running Steam on your local network.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: iPlayPC sends your voice to your PC for voice chat when Microphone is on in settings.
